categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: power distribution equipment, vehicle parts, automation equipment and components, and other digital products. Power distribution includes heavy electrical products, low-voltage switches, industrial control products, and integrated engineering equipment. Vehicle parts focus on automotive electrical components and EV powertrain systems. Automation covers programmable logic controllers, servo motors, inverters, and system integration services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include manufacturing of transformers, circuit breakers, and automotive electrical components with advanced features like AI applications, energy-saving transformers, and smart monitoring platforms. Production methods emphasize intelligent manufacturing, quality control, and compliance with international certifications such as ISO 14001, IATF 16949, and ISO 9001. The company also integrates digital and smart technologies like AIOT, MES, and e-Factory in production.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international power utilities, automotive manufacturers (especially domestic car makers), semiconductor and machinery industries, and public infrastructure projects. Major markets are Taiwan, North America, Southeast Asia, China, Middle East, and Europe. The company serves sectors such as renewable energy, transportation, public works, and digital consumer products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing plants in Hsinchu and multiple branch offices across Taiwan. It has significant overseas presence and sales in North America, Southeast Asia, China, Middle East, and Europe. It also has subsidiaries and investments in Vietnam, China, and the USA, supporting global market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of electrical equipment, automotive parts, and automation systems. It also engages in system integration and engineering services, positioning itself as a key supplier and solution provider to utilities, automotive OEMs, and industrial customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding green energy, energy-saving, digitalization, and intelligent product lines to capture new energy market opportunities. R&D focuses on AI applications, smart grid technologies, EV powertrain systems, and advanced automation products. The company emphasizes intelligent manufacturing, product international certification, and talent acquisition in green energy, digitalization, and export markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electrical distribution equipment, automotive electrical components, and automation products. Additional income comes from system engineering contracts, digital product sales, and leasing. The company also benefits from overseas exports and integrated project contracts in green energy and public infrastructure.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading domestic market share in heavy electrical products (52%), switches (45%), automation products (36%), and automotive electrical components (51%). It competes with international and regional electrical equipment manufacturers, leveraging strong R&D, product quality, and strategic partnerships, including with Mitsubishi Electric. It positions itself as a top-tier supplier with comprehensive product lines and global certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$35.07 billion in the latest fiscal year, a 10.3% increase from the prior year, with pre-tax profit growing 28.5% to NT$4.0 billion. Total assets reached NT$58.39 billion, with equity of NT$38.38 billion, reflecting steady growth and strong profitability. R&D expenditure was about 1.9% of revenue, supporting ongoing innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, comprehensive product series from high to low voltage, and strong customer service. It differentiates through advanced technology integration such as AI, energy-saving designs, and smart monitoring platforms. Its extensive certifications and strategic alliances enhance competitiveness. The company also focuses on sustainable development, ESG compliance, and customized solutions for green energy and automotive electrification markets.
